race.description: Club Forster & Sporties Tuncurry Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: KISS OF GOLD (8) was a beaten short-priced favourite here nearly 3 weeks ago when having no luck at all in the run to the line. The blinkers are added, and she can set the record straight in this. Follow your money. LOVE GODDESS (10) ran on late when finishing second at Gosford a fortnight ago, and she will be hoping for a genuine tempo here as well. If the gaps come at the right time, then she can go one better. WAN LOST (7) set the pace and only faded out late, finishing fourth. He will strip a lot fitter and loses nothing with Aaron Bullock picking up the ride. Each-way. SUN TO ME (5) should still not be a maiden, and he can make full use of the pole position fresh up at this level. Keep him very safe.
